title: 飞书自动化包
tagline: 纪要、审批、多维表格全自动

editor_note.text: 把飞书里最耗人的几件事交出去:会后纪要、审批流转、每天的站会汇报,加上多维表格的增删改查。四件都是飞书官方 CLI 系的技能,彼此配合得本来就好。第一次用要配应用凭证,照提示走一遍就行,配完是真省事。团队重度用多维表格的话,lark-base 单装也值。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: Hand over the most draining parts of Lark: meeting minutes, approval flows, daily standup reports, plus CRUD on Base tables. All four are official Lark CLI skills, so they work well together out of the box. First use requires app credentials — follow the prompts once and it genuinely saves time after. If your team lives in Base, lark-base alone is worth installing.

tagline_en: Minutes, approvals, and Base tables on autopilot
